gold_miners.reasoning: NEM jumped 4.8% on a gold bounce, which is already priced. Only analyst pieces and peer call transcripts; no NEM guidance or production headline. Gold is still 23% below its high with 10-year yields firm.

chips.reasoning: The semi ETF rebounded 6.9% in a day after a 13% 20-day slide; that is a driver move and a rebound is not a catalyst. The Moonshot/Nvidia chips item is not a clear one-sided NVDA event.

pharma.reasoning: Thesis intact and no adverse LLY news. Keep the position to the original horizon (about 2026-08-06, 4-5 trading days left). Q2 earnings add variance, so confidence is only just at the bar; exit at the horizon.
